نضطرم (form VIII)
# نَضْطَرِمُ (naḍṭarimu) /nadˤ.tˤa.ri.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِضْطَرَمَ (iḍṭarama)
# نَضْطَرِمَ (naḍṭarima) /nadˤ.tˤa.ri.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِضْطَرَمَ (iḍṭarama)
# نَضْطَرِمْ (naḍṭarim) /nadˤ.tˤa.rim/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِضْطَرَمَ (iḍṭarama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
